text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...She said it was shiny and you could 
stick it anywhere, so this has gotta be 
it!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
True, it will shine when light reflects 
off it! Then, if we hold this, we too 
shall—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted two people you wouldn't 
normally see in a variety shop. They 
seemed to be having an intense discussion 
in front of some reflective tape.
choice_data_list: What are you two up to?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer! This is training in keeping up 
with trends!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: The truth behind that is, actually—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You know those glitter stickers I bought 
the other day? I'm thinking of cutting 
them out tonight to decorate my phone!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Nice! Being able to slice it up is so 
convenient! If there's any left over, give 
me some!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Guess it can't be helped~. What about you, 
Bamboo? Do you want some glitter stickers?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Umm, as for me...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yaeno... what's an 'exhausted sticker'?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I don't know either. All they 
mentioned was that it was something 
sparkly, though...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't follow the conversation at 
all... Are we really that out of touch 
with trends...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Then all I gotta do is learn! Where 
there's a will, there's a way! Here 
goes—!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And so! That's how we ended up training!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
These are the trendy stickers everyone's 
talking about!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Make it sparkly!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You can stick it anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It can even portion it out! No doubt about 
it!
choice_data_list:
(Is reflective tape in fashion or 
something!?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Extremely doubtful. I decided to 
follow them to see if the two of them were 
actually keeping up with the trends."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This is the place for your next training 
session.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I heard that getting fancy with custom 
toppings at cafes is all the rage lately."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Haaee, that's a crazy amount of toppings! 
I don't even know which one to pick...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Argh, whatever! I'm just gonna pile it 
all on, 'ssu! Bigger is always better, 
'ssu!!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Th-This is... a café latte... right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What was brought out was something akin 
to a parfait heaped with whipped cream and 
nuts. There was so much cream, it looked 
ready to spill over at any second."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! So much power! As expected of the 
latest trending item!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"This is the final training ground. A 
trendy, picture-perfect hotspot. This 
place is—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Hold up! I figured out why it's so 
popular!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! The fruits of your training...!? And 
what, pray tell, is the reason?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It's the view from the top!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It makes me wanna climb all the way to the 
top too, boss!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's the perfect place for an Umamusume 
aiming for the top!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I see, what magnificent insight...! As 
expected of you, Bamboo-san!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I truly believed it was only popular for 
its looks... I must reflect upon my own 
shallowness...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Man, keeping up with trends ain't half 
bad!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. By understanding the reasoning behind 
trends, I was able to gain new insights.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Above all, it was thoroughly enjoyable. 
Trends are surprisingly profound, aren't 
they!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Right! I'll keep chasing the latest 
trends! Trends are always changing, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Ossu! Let us latch onto the trends 
together!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True or not, as long as she has the drive 
to keep up with the trends, she'll be 
fine. She'll definitely have an easier 
time chatting with her peers now.
choice_data_list:
Make sure you don't get too far ahead of 
the trend.

Make sure you don't get too far ahead of 
the trend.

text_block_list.text:

to keep up with the trends, she'll be 
fine. She'll definitely have an easier 
time chatting with her peers now.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...What happens if I overtake them?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
At the front... In other words, could this 
be the cutting edge of the era!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'd rather blow right past 
them!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, just like that "picture-perfect 
spot," let us aim for the summit 
together!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm used to going fast, sir! No matter 
what trend it is, I'll catch right up to 
it, sir!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Right! I will definitely keep chasing the 
cutting edge of fashion!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: For that reason, all I can do is train!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of them showed their unwavering 
resolve to keep pursuing the latest 
trends.
